seo_title: Bandhani Anarkali Gown Styling Guide for Wedding Guests (2026)
seo_description: How to style a bandhani Anarkali gown for a wedding, sangeet or mehndi: best colours, jewellery, shoes, printed vs hand-tied bandhani, and winter layering tips.
body:
## Quick answer

A **bandhani Anarkali gown** is one of the easiest outfits to wear as a wedding guest. The full flared skirt looks festive, the bandhani dots feel traditional, and a floor-length gown needs no dupatta to look complete. It works best for the **sangeet, mehndi, cocktail and reception**. For the main ceremony at a traditional wedding, add a dupatta or choose a richer fabric. Pair it with **silver or oxidised jewellery**, block heels and a small potli bag, and you are ready.

This guide is for guests at Indian weddings in India, the USA, the UK, Canada, the UAE and Australia.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Every piece is stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

## What is bandhani?

Bandhani (also called bandhej) is a tie-dye craft from Rajasthan and Gujarat. Artisans pinch tiny points of fabric, tie them tightly with thread and dye the cloth. When the threads are opened, each tied point leaves a small undyed dot. Thousands of these dots form waves, diamonds and circles.

Today you will find two kinds of bandhani clothing:

| | Hand-tied bandhani | Bandhani print |
|---|---|---|
| How it is made | Tied and dyed by hand | The bandhani pattern is printed on the fabric |
| Look | Dots are slightly raised and uneven | Dots are flat and even |
| Fabrics | Usually silk, georgette, cotton | Any fabric, including chiffon |
| Price | Higher | More affordable |
| Best for | Heirloom pieces | Flowy gowns and party wear |

Both are correct to call bandhani, but a good seller will tell you which one you are buying. Our teal Anarkali gown uses a **bandhani print on chiffon**, which lets the skirt stay light and flowy.

## Which wedding events suit a bandhani gown?

| Event | Does a bandhani gown work? | Styling tip |
|---|---|---|
| Mehndi | Yes, very well | Choose bright colours and comfortable shoes; you will sit on the floor |
| Sangeet | Yes, the best choice | A full flare looks beautiful when you dance |
| Cocktail / reception | Yes | Add statement earrings and a metallic clutch |
| Haldi | Yes, if it is yellow or a light colour | Avoid expensive pieces; haldi stains |
| Main ceremony (pheras, nikah, anand karaj) | Sometimes | Add a dupatta to cover your head if the ceremony needs it |

For more on each event, see our guides on [what to wear to an Indian wedding in the USA](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-in-the-usa/) and [what to wear to a Punjabi wedding](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-punjabi-wedding-as-a-guest/).

## Best colours for a bandhani gown

Bandhani looks richest in deep, saturated colours with white dots:

- **Teal and peacock blue**: elegant, works for day and night, flatters most skin tones
- **Red and maroon**: very traditional, but check the bride is not wearing red
- **Mustard and yellow**: perfect for haldi and mehndi
- **Pink and rani**: joyful, great for sangeet
- **Green**: a lucky colour at many weddings, ideal for mehndi

Avoid **all black** and **all white** at most Hindu and Sikh weddings, as some families see them as unlucky.

## How to style it

### Jewellery
Bandhani is already busy, so keep jewellery simple and bold. **Silver or oxidised jhumkas, chandbalis or big round statement earrings** look best. Skip a heavy necklace with a square or high neckline.

### Shoes
Choose **block heels, wedges or embellished flats**. Stilettos sink into lawns and sit badly on floor seating at a mehndi. Make sure the gown just skims the floor with your shoes on.

### Bag
A **silver or gold potli bag** matches the festive look better than a modern clutch.

### Hair and makeup
Soft waves or a low bun show off the neckline and earrings. A small **bindi** completes the look.

### Belt
If your gown comes with a belt, wear it. It defines the waist and makes the flare look even fuller in photos.

## Winter weddings abroad: how to stay warm

Many Indian weddings in the USA, UK and Canada happen between November and February. To stay warm in a chiffon gown:

- Wear a **long coat** in camel, white or black over the gown between venues
- Add a **pashmina or velvet shawl** for outdoor photos
- Wear thin **skin-colour thermal leggings** under the gown; the flare hides them
- Choose **sheer full sleeves** rather than sleeveless

## Bandhani gown for tall and plus-size women

A floor-length gown is one of the best shapes for **tall women**, as there is no short hem to worry about. Check the gown length against your height before ordering. Read more in our guide for [tall women](/blog/indian-wedding-guest-outfits-for-tall-women/).

For **plus-size** guests, an Anarkali with a defined waist or belt and a full skirt is very flattering. See our [plus-size wedding guest guide](/blog/plus-size-indian-wedding-guest-outfits/).

## How to care for a chiffon bandhani gown

- Dry clean for the first wash
- Never wring chiffon; it loses its shape
- Store it on a padded hanger or folded with tissue paper
- Steam rather than iron directly

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I wear a bandhani gown to an Indian wedding as a non-Indian guest?**
Yes. A bandhani Anarkali gown is a respectful and popular choice for guests of any background. Avoid all black and all white, and carry a scarf in case the ceremony needs covered heads.

**Is a bandhani gown too casual for a wedding?**
No. In a flowy fabric with a full flare and a belt, it looks festive enough for the sangeet, mehndi and reception. For a very formal main ceremony, add a dupatta or choose silk.

**What is the difference between bandhani and leheriya?**
Both are tie-dye crafts from Rajasthan. Bandhani makes small dots, while leheriya makes diagonal wave-like stripes.

**Which colour bandhani gown suits brown skin?**
Teal, emerald, mustard, maroon and rani pink all look beautiful on brown and wheatish skin tones.

**What should I wear under a sheer chiffon gown?**
A good chiffon gown has an inner lining, so you do not need anything extra. In winter, thin thermal leggings work well under a floor-length flare.
